"""Worst-case-ish single batch: definitions, frames, events, requests, chunks."""
import json, subprocess, sys, time, resource
NDEF = 8192
NCASE = 1000
FR_PER_CASE = 16          # 16000 frames
NEV = 16000
NPARTS = 18000            # 16000+16000+18000 = 50000 items
definitions = [["d0", "b'ab\\ncd'"]] + [["d%d" % i, "d%d + b'x' * 2" % (i - 1)] for i in range(1, NDEF)]
cases = []
for i in range(NCASE):
    frames = []
    for j in range(FR_PER_CASE):
        if j == 0:
            frames.append({"Type": "headers", "End_Stream": False,
                           "headers_kv": {":method": "GET", ":path": "/t%d" % i}})
        elif j % 4 == 1:
            frames.append({"Type": "data", "data_to_transfered": "{{ d%d[0:8] }}" % (NDEF - 1), "End_Stream": False})
        elif j % 4 == 2:
            frames.append({"Type": "datagram", "data_to_transfered": "g<<random_string>>"})
        else:
            frames.append({"Type": "sleep", "Time_to_Stop": 1})
    frames.append({"Type": "headers", "End_Stream": True, "data_to_transfered": [["z", "z"]]})
    cases.append({"name": "c%d" % i, "frames": frames,
                  "expect": {"method": "GET", "target": "/t%d" % i, "host": "h.example"}})
events = []
for i in range(NEV):
    if i % 500 == 499:
        events.append({"at": i % 50, "kind": "data", "stream": 4 * (i % NCASE), "data": "{{ d100 }}", "end": True})
    else:
        events.append({"at": i % 50, "kind": "headers", "stream": 4 * (i % NCASE),
                       "fields": [[":status", "200"], ["x", "<<random_string>>"]], "end": False})
req_plain = "GET /t0 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"
req_chunk = "GET /t0 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n1\r\nz\r\n1\r\nz\r\n0\r\n\r\n"
channels = []
per = NPARTS // 256
for c in range(256):
    parts = []
    for p in range(per):
        if (c * per + p) % 2 == 0:
            parts.append({"case": "c%d" % ((c + p) % NCASE), "data": req_plain})
        else:
            parts.append({"case": None, "data": req_chunk})
    channels.append({"name": "ch%d" % c, "parts": parts})
d = {"seed": "max.batch-1", "definitions": definitions, "timeout_ms": 100000,
     "cases": cases, "events": events, "channels": channels}
s = json.dumps(d)
items = sum(len(c['frames']) for c in cases) + len(events) + sum(len(c['parts']) for c in channels)
pairs = sum(len(f.get('headers_kv', f.get('data_to_transfered', []))) for c in cases for f in c['frames']) + sum(len(e.get('fields', [])) for e in events)
print('json bytes', len(s), 'items', items, 'pairs', pairs)
t = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', 'main.py'], cwd='/workspace/project', input=s.encode(),
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
el = time.time() - t
print('elapsed %.2fs rc %d out %d bytes' % (el, p.returncode, len(p.stdout)))
print('stderr', p.stderr.decode()[-300:])
print('child maxrss MB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss / 1024)
o = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
if 'cases' in o:
    print('cases', len(o['cases']), 'channels', len(o['channels']),
          'requests', sum(len(c['requests']) for c in o['channels']),
          'states', sorted({c['state'] for c in o['cases']}))
    print('sample case', json.dumps(o['cases'][0])[:260])
    print('sample req', json.dumps(o['channels'][0]['requests'][0])[:300])
else:
    print(o)
EOF
